title: General and Electronic Concepts of Oxidation and Reduction
topicTitle: General and electronic concept of oxidation and reduction
notes: **Classical concept:** oxidation is addition of oxygen or removal of hydrogen; reduction is removal of oxygen or addition of hydrogen.
**Electronic concept:** oxidation is loss of electrons; reduction is gain of electrons. This is the most general definition and works for all reactions.
**Oxidizing agent:** the species that accepts electrons and gets reduced. It causes oxidation of the other reactant.
**Reducing agent:** the species that donates electrons and gets oxidized. It causes reduction of the other reactant.
**Simultaneous process:** oxidation and reduction always occur together because electrons lost by one species are gained by another.
